Name: Mire Grub
Description: Soft and slow. There are always more of them.

Name: Bog Lurker
Description: Its hide turns the first couple of hits.

Name: Fen Stalker
Description: Waits at the back and picks its moment.

Name: The Reed Warden
Description: A small bounty and a good first kill. Two layers, and the bark only turns one point a hit.

Name: The Marsh King
Description: Three layers of him, and each one is harder than the last.

Name: Furnace Husk
Description: Goes for your best player, not your worst.

Name: The Ash Tyrant
Description: Hits every tier at once. Bring stamina.

Name: Hollow Weaver
Description: Spins in the dark. Nothing clever, just persistent.

Name: The Hollow Mother
Description: The deepest thing down there, and the last one.
